body: Vimal Kejriwal (MD & CEO) on 2026-01-30 (Q3FY26 concall transcript): "If you're looking at 9% to 10%, then I can always say FY '28" Metric: Consolidated EBITDA margin. Target: 9-10%. Deadline: 2028-03-31. Specificity: range; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-21: moved-goalpost. Evidence: May-26: double digit 'maybe FY29'. Nov-26: 'FY28 ... whether we'll achieve 7% or 8% or 9% is difficult to say'. The FY28 9-10% was not referred to.
